scope: Two pure proof/unsigned-layout vectors and one public-scalar synthetic mint. No real inputs, network, node acceptance, wallet approval or production capability evidence.

provenance.signatureScope: Proof vectors use DER r=1,s=1 placeholders only: ABI shape, not ECDSA validity. Only mint uses public scalar 1 for offline synthetic P2PKH signing.
provenance.digestEncoding: Exact bytes returned by tbc-lib-js Transaction.Sighash.sighash(..., 0x41); compare this digest in the existing native signing convention.
provenance.proofScope: Synthetic parent witnesses are deliberate placeholders. Upstream proof encoding checks linkage, not full validity of the synthetic history.
